Best position, I think.''"<br />"''You want to go around behind.''"<br />"''It's risky, but we can make it.''"<br />"''Okay, let's go for it, sir.|Anakin Skywalker and Captain Rex|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref>}}
An '''energy sphere building''' stood in [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Crystal City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], a [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]], led by [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] used the roof of the building as a jumping-off point to assault a trio of [[Octuptarra magna tri-droid/Legends|octuptarra magna tri-droids]].
